about: veffchop: chops the current drum kit's sample into the 24 drum keys, for OS 1.7.3. A sequencer for the drum that plays nothing itself and lets every key through; its page shows the sample's wave, the cuts as the knobs move them and which slice each key plays. Modes: transient (sensitivity), lazy (zero crossings, short slices merged), equal (N parts); mapping in order or onto the stock kit's layout, with or without wrap. A press of the fourth knob writes the 24 start/end points of the current slot; shift and that press puts the kit's own back. It changes no place of the firmware and needs the base.
name: veffchop
